title: From neurons to GPT
description: Build visual intuition, understand learning, then write a neural network and a transformer. A suggested sequence; the coding lectures assume basic Python.

title: When one computer isn't enough
description: Start with the distributed systems problem, explore consensus and consistency, then see how real systems are designed and tested.

title: How we got here
description: A journey through codebreaking, interactive computing, BASIC, Unix, and the open web. Ordered around the ideas, not the upload dates.

title: See the mathematics
description: Vectors, determinants, eigenvectors, and waves. Visual explanations that make abstract ideas tangible; each is an entry point for deeper study.
